Results.ReviewText: I had read both favorible, and negative reviews of this product. Considering the terrible luck that I had with 2 cycle weed eaters, I decided to take a chance. I assembled the unit myself with few problems but did not put on either the string cutter head or the brush cutter head. I wanted this primarily for the brush cutter head. I had my eldest son come over and help me put on the brush cutter head. The instruction manual guide to doing this print was small and images were small, and dark, so I thought it better to have my son back me up on installing the brush cutter, we accomplished this successfully. I went to my local gas station and purchased premium gasoline with no ethanol content, I had 10W30 motor oil in the garage already. I used a measuring cup to pour 20 Ounces of gas into the unit's gas tank . I measured out 2.7 Ounces of 10W30 motor oil with a measuring cup, and put the oil in the unit's oil receptacle. I followed the manuals starting instruction by placing the motor lever in the start position, pressing the gas filler bulb ten times to feed fuel into the motor, and pulled the pull cord five times, as recommended. The motor sputtered, and I had to pull the pull cord twice more and it fired right up. I then set the lever on the motor to the run position and used the unit to cut brush for over an hour using a full tank on fuel. The unit works well and starts well following the startup procedure in the owner's manual. It fired right up everytime I use it with no problems whatsoever. You would think that 2.7 Ounces of motor oil is not very much. It seems to burn very little oil, just to be save you want to check the oil level each time you use the unit. I was very happy, and satisfied with the purchase of this unit, and would recommend it to others. I think that it's a winner, and it was a great buy from Home Depot.

311424786.Description: Stop mixing oil and gas and take control of your lawn care with the powerful and versatile Wild Badger Power 4-Cycle Straight Shaft 2-in-1 Grass Trimmer and Brush Cutter. This tool has a grass trimmer attachment for detail work along borders and a brush cutter blade for heavier grasses and brush clearing. It also includes a harness to relieve the strain on your arms and improve stability. Powered by a 31cc, 4-cycle, full-crank engine, your trimmer is designed for reliability. The full crank design delivers a fast start and smooth operation reducing emissions, increasing fuel efficiency and delivering longer life. The transmission is supported by an aluminum casing which greatly reduces vibration allowing you to work in comfort until the job is done. The straight shaft is built with a robust aluminum tube which is lightweight and durable for added comfort and convenience. The twist-n-load bump feed trimmer head allows for quick line feed for the twin line cutting system. Replacing the line will no longer eat up precious daylight and will give you more time to get your lawn and landscaping looking clean.
